sections.title: Sound of letter u
paragraphs: The letter (u) /y/ is named (u) /y/. Its main sound is heard in (usine) /y.zin/, which means factory. This letter makes two distinct sounds in spoken French.

sections.title: How to say u
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your tongue forward against your bottom teeth. Push your lips forward into a tight small circle and vibrate your voice. Touch your throat to feel the steady vibration. For the second sound, make this same shape and quickly glide into the next vowel.

sections.title: Spelling of u
paragraphs: In most words, this vowel gives the full sound /y/, as in (sûr) /syʁ/. When it stands directly before another spoken vowel, it becomes a brief glide /ɥ/. You hear this gliding sound in (huit) /ɥit/ and (nuit) /nɥi/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not replace this sound with the vowel of boot. Keep your tongue pushed forward, like saying beet, but push your lips into a tight circle. Do not add a glide sound like you hear in music.
